text: Free roguelike demo where one of the heroes is a robot that launches corn.
Pixel-art heroes in a low-poly 3D world, surrounded by hordes, clearing the screen with huge attacks.
The other picks are a holy knight, and a wizard girl with a very angry cat.
Best moment in the trailer: a beam from the sky flattening everything around you.
The catch? Some biomes, like the checkerboard one, look pretty empty.
Solo or four-player online. The demo is about three gigs, and the full game is dated October twenty-ninth.
Think Vampire Survivors, but loud and in 3D.
Worth a dip. Bring the corn.
